item.title: Anthropic's open-source framework for AI-powered vulnerability discovery
item.description:
📝 Defending Code Reference Harness A reference implementation for autonomous vulnerability discovery and remediation with Claude, based on our learnings from partnering with security teams at several organizations since launching Claude Mythos Preview. This repository is an open-source reference implementation based on general best practices for finding vulnerabilities using Claude. Open this repo in Claude Code and run /quickstart to get oriented.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/anthropics/defending-code-reference-harness

item.title: Castor: CERN Advanced STORage Manager
item.description:
📝 The tape access (writes and recalls) is controlled by the Tape Infrastructure. ) Tape Infrastructure - under certain conditions CASTOR saves files onto tape in order to provide data safety and to manage data storage that is larger than the available disks. The CASTOR Volume Manager database contains information about each tape's characteristics, capacity and status.
🔗 Read more: https://castor.web.cern.ch/content/home.html
